When learned you get up to ^o7 minions^* that follow you around, gaining 1 every 6 seconds. Target an enemy to throw the first one at them, doing one of three things:

- ^bBLUE^*: Deals ^o{70,90,110,130} Magic Damage^*, chaining to nearby enemies.
- ^rRED^*: same as ^bBLUE^*, plus a stacking ^o{15,20,25,30} Magic Damage^* (max 5 stacks) and a ^o{10,15,20,25}% Tapering Movespeed Slow^* over {3} seconds in the AOE
- ^gGREEN^*: Same as ^rRED^*, but bounces to two additional nearby enemies.

english:
Target an enemy hero to Mark them for ^o{8,10,12,14} seconds^*.

When you attack, your Attack will ^obounce to the Marked Target^* if they are within a 800 unit radius of your main target. If attacking the Marked target, it will bounce to the closest nearby enemy hero within radius.

A Marked target cannot dodge attacks, has ^o-{20,30,40,50}% Armor^*, and becomes Sighted & Revealed.

If ^oLuck of the Draw^* is leveled, you gain a flat +10% Critical Chance against the Marked target.

Помеченная цель не может уклоняться от атак, получает ^o-{20,30,40,50}% брони^*, обнаруживается и раскрывается.

Can be purchased once per player. Cannot be dropped. Rewards are permanent.

Form a pact with Ophelia. Earn ^g25 points^* to unlock a permanent ^oRaven^* upgrade of your choice.

^oHow to earn points:^*
- Assist in a Kill: ^g+1 pt^*
- Stack a neutral camp: ^g+3 pts^*
- Place a Ward of Sight: ^g+2 pts^*
- Destroy an enemy Ward of Sight: ^g+3 pts^*
- Place a Raven: ^g+1 pt^*

Upon reaching 25 points, choose one of three permanent rewards:

^pWatcher's Unity^*: ^oRaven^* gains +300 sight range, +30 seconds duration, and gives Clearvision for 10 seconds upon landing.

^cRavenSeer^*: Gain an aura that reveals ^oRavens^* in 1000 radius and +400 cast range for ^oRavens^*.

^rRavenBane^*: ^oRaven^* kills enemy ^oRavens^* upon landing in a 1300 radius. Reduce the ^oRaven^* cooldown by 30 seconds for each enemy ^oRaven^* killed.

All rewards grant an extra 50 gold upon killing enemy ^oRavens^*.
